name: Bug report
about: Something is broken or behaving unexpectedly

labels: bug

---

## What happened

A clear description of what went wrong.

## What you expected

What you thought should happen instead.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Click '...'
3. See error

## Environment

- OS: [e.g. macOS 15.1, Windows 11]
- Browser (web): [e.g. Chrome 131, Arc 1.50]
- Desktop app version (electron): [e.g. v0.1.0]
- Node version: `node --version`
- pnpm version: `pnpm --version`

## Scene file or screen recording

If the bug is layout-, animation-, or export-related, please attach the
`.arnimotion` file or a short screen recording. Most reports are
much easier to resolve with a real repro.

## Console errors

Open DevTools (View → Toggle Developer Tools in the desktop app, or
Cmd/Ctrl+Option+I in the browser) and paste any red errors here.

## Additional context

Anything else that might help.
